Don't build your future on borrowed rails!

Most Web3 teams only realize the risk when they hit the
company.description:
Don't build your future on borrowed rails!

Most Web3 teams only realize the risk when they hit the scaling wall.

Third-party custody SaaS feels efficient early on - fast APIs, minimal setup. But as volume grows, so does dependency: fees scale with flow, uptime sits outside your control, and compliance becomes shared risk.

Instead of compounding dependency, Gaian_hq reclaimed their rails. They moved to a Self-hosted MPC architecture deployed inside their own cloud (AWS/GCP).

Working with @fystack, Gaian ensured:
- Sovereignty: Key shares and signing logic remain within their domain.
- Automation: Wallet sweeps operate under defined, programmable policies.
- Efficiency: Cross-chain liquidity shifted from manual coordination to deterministic control.

In 2026, the durable advantage belongs to companies that own the ground they stand on.

Speed creates opportunity. Infrastructure ownership preserves it.
